rows.input: EVM block header + sourceFinalityProof (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche)
rows.assumed_property: The header is part of the source chain's settled (finalized) history, on the named chain

required_properties.property: header anchored to settled history (light client, checkpoint, validator signatures or confirmations)
chain id read from chain data, not from the caller's claim

rows.gap: Only keccak(header) == claimed hash, claimed height == header number, and claimed chain id == the reader's own constant. The claimed chain id is the caller's word; an Ethereum header carries no chain id. Nothing ties the header to any real chain. EthereumLockReader (beacon light client) exists but the ceremony registers SimpleEthereumLockReader; the checkers/ finality contracts are never called by any reader.
rows.exploit_sketch: Run a local fork, create a real-looking lock, then rewrite header fields (mixHash, parentHash) so the header exists on no chain; the receipt proof still matches its receiptsRoot. Submit with claimed chain id 1. Known Oct 22 finding (non_base_finality_trust_model.test.cjs): about 311 VCLM per forged lock.
rows.damage_potential: Unlimited VCLM mint up to the 500,000,000 hard cap, and CHONX after activation, with no real asset locked. Inflated supply also inflates RAC and stake rewards.
rows.rev_conflict: Rev 6 VF-XCH-006/008: no issuance before documented exact finality; relayer cannot waive finality. Code accepts a self-consistent header with no finality at all. Mitigation in config only: commit 5a21665 says the live Base ceremony is Base-only until settled-history checkers exist; build_ceremony_artifacts.cjs still ships these readers.
